content.short: MetaCRM moves data from Smart Contracts to a smarter CRM.
content.description: MetaCRM is a complete CRM solution for Web3 projects that covers every phase of the customer journey—from acquisition to retention and ongoing engagement. By integrating and analyzing data from both Web2 and Web3 sources, MetaCRM uncovers new user insights and supports teams in reducing Web3-specific customer experience friction by streamlining processes and consolidating channels of communication across diverse touchpoints and interactions.
content.meta: MetaCRM is a CRM solution for Web3 projects that supports the customer journey. Discover MetaCRM and other DeFi Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
